description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Voucher' class in the namespace Opencart\Catalog\Model\Checkout. It contains methods for managing voucher operations such as adding, deleting, retrieving, and updating vouchers and voucher histories within the OpenCart e-commerce system.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Represents the Voucher model responsible for handling voucher-related database operations such as adding, retrieving, disabling, and deleting vouchers and voucher histories.

methods.name: addVoucher
methods.description: Inserts a new voucher record into the database associated with a specific order ID, returning the new voucher's ID.

methods.name: deleteVouchersByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes all vouchers associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: disableVoucher
methods.description: Sets the status of a voucher linked to a specific order ID to disabled (status = 0).

methods.name: getVoucher
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a voucher identified by its code, including validating the voucher's association with an order and its status.

methods.name: getVoucherByCode
methods.description: Fetches voucher details by voucher code, joining related theme and description tables.

methods.name: getVoucherTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total amount used from a specific voucher.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a record to the voucher history table, tracking voucher usage against an order and amount.

methods.name: deleteHistoriesByOrderId
methods.description: Removes all voucher history records associated with a specific order ID.
